body:
# ChatGPT Review — Batch B2, 2026-11-04

Reviewed PR #132 exact HEAD `97a2c647af4610860b63af909b6c512917ec7ac3` and `README.md`, `SOURCE_METADATA_AUDIT.json`, `IDENTITY_CANDIDATES.json`, `CONFLICTS_AND_FAILURES.json`, `ENTITY_SCHEMA.json` listing, `BATCH_C_PROTOCOL_ADDENDUM.md`, `NEXT_SESSION.md` and the local structural validation receipt. GitHub PR remains OPEN/DRAFT/NOT MERGED; no commit status checks or associated PR workflow runs were returned.

**Outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS as a bounded metadata/identity-candidate research milestone; full physical-site identity reconciliation remains PARTIAL; scientific admission PENDING.** The five metadata source records are federal, NSW and QLD leads, not five surveyed facilities. Two QLD official historical WetlandInfo page candidates: South Rockhampton sewage treatment plant (2019 reported Operational) and West Rockhampton sewage treatment plant (2019 reported Not operational). Both have the same approval holder but separate names/locations/status; retain distinct candidates pending verification. `63(1e)` is an activity category, not the licence ID; RP1 is a monitoring point linked to South, not a facility. Approval holder is not proven operator. Official site/process/instrument IDs, current operator, numerical coords/CRS/accuracy, current operational status, throughput and gas capture are still unknown/null. No landfill sample was admitted, no national count or emissions estimated. The sample is availability-driven, not representative.

**Licence/reuse review:** QLD authors attribute selected text facts to agency CC BY 4.0 default with third-party/image exceptions. This is a reasonable *conditional* basis for attributed short factual-field extracts, not a blanket certification of rights over every subresource. Source terms and authoritativeness should be rechecked before broader redistribution. Federal workbook-specific rights were not verified; NSW restrictions led to no actual rows being republished. This is a sound conservative stop. NSW EPSG:4283 polygon metadata has no position accuracy in metres. Geoscience Australia ordinal confidence and conflicting metadata creation/modification dates do not justify invented metre-level precision or a confirmed active downloadable layer. QLD robot challenge was stopped.

**Scientific and data caveats:** `A_SCOPED_HISTORICAL_PAGE` is evidence of a dated historical page, not fully verified identity nor plant operational condition in 2026. Local structural/browser `PASS` is not science verification; raw full HTTP response bodies were not captured and there is no GitHub CI result. B2 does NOT demonstrate methane generation, emissions, facility boundaries or climate response.

**Safe next recommendation:** (1) perform one more narrow public-source reconciliation for the two Rockhampton sites (independent official site/instrument IDs and current operation, operator, permits, facility vs monitoring-point semantics), plus one accessible official landfill candidate so that the planned waste emphasis is represented; keep unknowns and failed attempts. (2) Confirm permitted source reuse, temporal validity, coordinate CRS and position accuracy if discoverable. (3) Do not force completion if evidence is unavailable. (4) In parallel, refine the Batch C extreme-climate and multigas *research protocol only*: observed-vs-forecast ENSO/IOD/SAM vintage; station-vs-reactor T; event thresholds/lag; controls/loads; CH4 generation/oxidation/capture/destruction vs emitted flux; N2O, biogenic/fossil CO2, electricity and refrigerants. (5) Slides-style local report, provenance, updated canonical index and NEXT_SESSION, retain PR Draft. **No calculations, modelling experiments, national extrapolation, deployment, PR merge, restricted access bypass, Council-private data or scientific promotion without Founder approval.**

**Project states:** P0 baseline PARTIAL; P1-A scientific PENDING; Batch B source catalogue ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS; Batch B2 limited metadata/identity candidate review ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS / IDENTITY_PARTIAL; Batch C PROPOSAL_ONLY.

CRP: knowledge—source metadata differs from real plant, approval differs from operator; idea—one official landfill + tighter 2-site reconciliation; wish—spatially traceable facility evidence; reasoning—current status/IDs/coords must precede facility model; decision—accept limited B2; unknowns—permit links, precise positions, operating status and process measurements; next—narrow B2 completion attempt + Batch C protocol. Keywords: CarbonOS, landfill, sewage, QLD, NSW, GIS, methane, MRV, extreme climate.
